# FitsAbroad

> FitsAbroad is a coupon and deals aggregator plus blog covering travel, fashion, and lifestyle brands. It publishes verified discount codes, store directories, and buying guides.

## Key pages
- [Deals](https://fitsabroad.com/deals.html): Current coupon codes and offers
- [Stores](https://fitsabroad.com/stores.html): Directory of participating stores
- [Categories](https://fitsabroad.com/categories.html): Browse deals by category
- [About](https://fitsabroad.com/about.html): About FitsAbroad
